parts.title: Preface, Learning Objectives & Syllabus
parts.summary: Target audience, prerequisites, core mental models, and reading path guide.

parts.title: Part 1: Runtime Primitives, Type Systems & Edge Toolchains

children.title: 1.1 Cloudflare Workers Runtime & V8 Isolates
children.summary: V8 isolate architecture, event loop, fetch event lifecycle, and non-blocking telemetry via ctx.waitUntil().

children.title: 1.2 Strict TypeScript & Zero-any Domain Modeling
children.summary: Compiler flags, branded types for microdollars, discriminated unions, and exhaustive pattern matching.

children.title: 1.3 Web Crypto API & Low-Level Byte Primitives
children.summary: crypto.subtle, ArrayBuffer and Uint8Array manipulation, hex/base64url codecs, and constant-time operations.

children.title: 1.4 Toolchain, Miniflare Simulation & Fast Quality Gates
children.summary: pnpm workspace, wrangler, local workerd simulation, and the <10s make gate mandate.

children.title: 2.1 The Reciprocal Exchange: Economics & Tragedy of the Commons
children.summary: Stranded capacity problem, reciprocal key sharing, and credit/debt equilibrium.

children.title: 2.2 Distributed Actor Model & Durable Objects Topology
children.summary: Actor model in Cloudflare Workers, single-threaded execution, and 3-actor topology.

children.title: 2.3 The Architectural Invariants & Security Constitution
children.summary: No plaintext keys, tenant isolation, fixed-point microdollars, and transactional persistence.

children.title: 2.4 Legal Compliance, ToS Boundaries & Automated Mediation
children.summary: Provider ToS analysis, C1-C3/K1-K2 attestations, liability firewalls, and dispute mediation.

children.title: 2.5 High-Level Design (HLD), Capacity Planning & Cloudflare Cost Model
children.summary: Edge data plane vs control plane, latency budgets, and full Cloudflare hosting cost model across 3 scopes.

parts.title: Part 3: Guided Subsystem Tours & Low-Level Designs (LLDs)

children.title: 3.1 Ingress Gateway & Edge Auth Middleware (LLD)
children.summary: Edge gateway ingress, OpenAPI route dispatch, token verification, and telemetry emitter.

children.title: 3.2 Intelligent Cascade Router & Capability Engine (LLD)
children.summary: Waterfall cascade routing, W_provider scoring formula, model capability matching, and fallback logic.

children.title: 3.3 Communal Pool Engine & Coordinator Actor (LLD)
children.summary: PoolCoordinatorDO, communal key leases, round-robin rotation, and anti-stampede locks.

children.title: 3.4 Community Debt Engine & Credit Economics (LLD)
children.summary: TenantQuotaDO, fixed-point microdollar debt ledger, credit accrual, and overdraft enforcement.

children.title: 3.5 Anti-Cheat, Anti-Sybil & Key Sentinels (LLD)
children.summary: AntiSybilEngine, proof-of-work challenges, key health probes, and parasitic drain detection.

children.title: 3.6 Private Key Actor & Circuit Breakers (LLD)
children.summary: KeyPoolDO, sliding-window RPM counters, circuit breaker trip states, and transactional DO storage sync.

children.title: 3.7 Zero-Leak Streaming Proxy & Error Sanitizer (LLD)
children.summary: SSETransformer, TransformStream chunk parsing, ErrorSanitizer error masking, and backpressure handling.

children.title: 3.8 Cryptographic Defense, Nonces & HKDF Derivation (LLD)
children.summary: Web Crypto AES-256-GCM, HKDF key derivation, 12-byte cryptographically secure nonces, and zero plaintext in D1.

children.title: 3.9 Storage Engine, D1 SQLite & Repositories (LLD)
children.summary: D1StorageAdapter, repository pattern, API keys table, daily spend rollups, and batch write transactions.

children.title: 3.10 Legal Contracts, Attestations & Mediation Protocols (LLD)
children.summary: ProviderAttestation contracts, terms verification, dispute mediation, and credit refund arbitration.

children.title: 3.11 Golden Verification Suites & CI/CD Quality Gates (LLD)
children.summary: Mock D1/DO test harnesses, golden prompt integration suites, and the <10s make gate contract.

parts.title: Part 4: End-to-End Execution Lifecycles & Dynamic Tracing

children.title: 4.1 Direct Private Key Inference & The Sub-15ms Hot-Path
children.summary: Step-by-step trace of private key inference, latency budgets, and zero-copy streaming.

children.title: 4.2 Communal Failover, Lease Allocation & Debt Settlement Flow
children.summary: Trace of 429 failover, communal lease grant, token usage extraction, and double-entry debt/credit settlement.

children.title: 4.3 Anti-Cheat Sentinel, Key Invalidation & Auto-Mediation Flow
children.summary: Trace of fraudulent/exhausted key submission, probe failure, quarantine protocol, and dispute arbitration.

children.title: 4.4 Zero-Leak Error Sanitization, Upstream Outages & Emergency Brake
children.summary: Trace of upstream provider outage, SSETransformer error trap, ErrorSanitizer redaction, and circuit breaker trip.

parts.title: Part 5: Production Engineering, Architectural Trade-Offs & SRE Operations

children.title: 5.1 Architectural Patterns in Edge Systems
children.summary: Smart Facade Pattern, Distributed Actor Pattern, Defensive Perimeters, and Backpressure Transformers.

children.title: 5.2 Comprehensive Trade-Off Matrix (Quantitative Decisions)
children.summary: Fixed-point vs float, DO in-memory state vs D1 persistence, AES-GCM vs ChaCha20, and streaming vs buffering.

children.title: 5.3 SRE Runbooks, Edge Failure Modes & Disaster Recovery
children.summary: Runbooks for D1 outages, DO memory eviction, provider stampedes, and tenant overdraft attacks.

children.title: 5.4 Observability, Distributed Tracing & Telemetry Architecture
children.summary: W3C distributed tracing, Workers Analytics Engine schema, and SLI/SLO dashboards.

parts.summary: 4 codebase scavenger hunts, 12-question master quiz with collapsible spoilers, and graduation coding challenge.
